description:
Who We Are

Stain Fix is a clean-tech brand dedicated to solving real stain problems with science-backed, enzyme-based solutions. We're US-based, trusted by thousands of customers on Amazon and Shopify.

Our Product Line

  • Instant Blood Stain Remover — Safe, effective formula that works on fresh and dried blood stains from nosebleeds, periods, cuts, medical situations, and more. Works on all fabric types.
  • Oil Stain Remover — Breaks down tough grease and oil stains on clothing and upholstery without harsh chemicals.

Coming Soon: Ink stain remover, sweat & deodorant stain remover, and expanded product offerings.

Why Customers Love Us

  • Enzyme-based formula (no bleach, no peroxide)
  • Safe for delicate fabrics (silks, wools, designer pieces)
  • Fast-acting (results in 10-15 minutes)
  • Works on fresh AND dried stains

• What Makes Us Different

✅ We Normalize Uncomfortable Conversations — Our blood stain remover doesn't shy away from periods, medical situations, or accidents. We say it plainly and without judgment.

✅ Enzyme-Based Science — Our formulas break down protein stains at a molecular level, not with harsh chemicals that damage fabrics.

✅ Multi-Use, Multi-Fabric — Works on clothing, sheets, mattresses, upholstery, and more. Safe for everything from silk to cotton to delicate baby items.

✅ Authentic Brand Philosophy — We partner with real creators and real people, not influencers pushing products they don't use. Your audience will feel the difference.

✅ Scaling Smart — We're expanding to new products and new markets while staying true to our quality standards. Early affiliates are building equity in a growing brand.

✅ Transparent & Trustworthy — Clear pricing, real results, honest customer reviews, and reliable fulfillment. No gimmicks.

• How Affiliates Can Earn

Commission Structure

  • 20% commission on every sale generated through your unique affiliate link
  • No caps, no limits — earn as much as you want
  • Unlimited earning potential — create 1 video or 100, the commission stays the same

How It Works (4 Simple Steps)

Step 1: Join
Apply to become a Stain Fix affiliate and get approved within 24-48 hours.

Step 2: Get Your Free Product
We'll ship you a free bottle of Stain Fix so you can test it, experience it, and create authentic content around it.

Step 3: Create & Share
Make a genuine UGC video on Instagram or TikTok showing how Stain Fix works. Keep it real—that's what converts. Tag us:

  • Instagram: @stain_fix
  • TikTok: @stain_fix

Step 4: Earn Commission
Every sale from your unique affiliate link earns you 20% commission. Payouts happen automatically on the 1st of every month.

Real Earning Examples

If you create one solid UGC video and it generates:

  • 10 sales: ~$50 (20% of ~$250)
  • 50 sales: ~$250 (20% of ~$1,250)
  • 100 sales: ~$500 (20% of ~$2,500)

Most creators see momentum grow after 2-3 videos as audiences discover them.

Customer Incentive: 10% Off

Your audience gets an exclusive 10% discount code when they purchase through your link or with your coupon code. Everyone wins—they save, you earn.

Payment Details

  • Payout Schedule: Automatically on the 1st of every month
  • Minimum Payout: No minimums (we pay out every commission)
  • Payment Method: Direct bank transfer or PayPal

• How to Promote Us

Content Ideas That Work

  • Problem-to-Solution Videos — Show the stain, apply Stain Fix, reveal the result
  • Personal Stories — Period leaks, kid's nosebleed, pet accident, work injury—real situations your audience relates to
  • Before/After Transformation — Close-ups of stain removal in action
  • Delicate Fabric Protection — Show how gentle the formula is on silk, wool, vintage pieces
  • Multi-Use Demonstrations — Clothing, sheets, mattresses, upholstery
  • Caregiver Content — For parents, nurses, or caregivers handling frequent stains
  • Q&A Breakdowns — Answer audience questions about stain removal

Platforms We Support

  • Instagram (Reels, Feed, Stories)
  • TikTok (Short-form videos)

Just tag us: @stain_fix on Instagram and TikTok

Marketing Assets We Provide

  • Product images and videos for reference
  • Detailed product scripts (3 personas with 30-sec scripts provided)
  • Usage instructions and application tips
  • FAQ document for common questions
  • Brand guidelines and messaging framework
  • Example UGC videos to inspire your content

Content Guidelines

✅ DO:

  • Create authentic, genuine content
  • Show real applications and real results
  • Use your own voice and personality
  • Film in natural settings (home, bedroom, laundry room)
  • Share your honest experience with the product

❌ DON'T:

  • Use overly polished, corporate-looking ads
  • Make exaggerated claims beyond the product's capabilities
  • Copy competitor messaging
  • Ignore product usage instructions
  • Post low-quality or blurry videos

Welcome to Stain Fix! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: support@stainfix.co.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to support@stainfix.co for support.
